body: live_claude_pids is an optional top-level HookPost field (skip when None), not a field of HookEvent::SessionStart/SessionEnd: adding it to the variants would touch ~93 construction sites; no wire VERSION bump

point 2: only SessionStart and SessionEnd hooks send the list; no agent-disconnect timer or candidate state. Slot choice happens only at SessionStart, which now carries fresh data from the same host; an agent-disconnect candidate cannot be confirmed without that data anyway

race guard: a session whose SessionStart arrived within REAP_GRACE (5 s, transient recent_starts map) is never reaped, because a start can overtake the POST of a snapshot taken before its process existed; alternative (hook sends process creation times) rejected as heavier

list includes every claude(.exe) and node(.exe) pid (Desktop claude.exe not filtered; an extra pid only keeps a session alive; node covers the npm-below-native own pid), capped at 1024 or no list; hub trusts a list only if it contains the posting event own claude_pid
spool::save drops live_claude_pids: a replayed stale list would end sessions started after it
e2e test first reused the LIVE session pid as the new session own pid; the existing reused-pid path in session_started then ended LIVE. Fixed the test with a separate stand-in per pid, not the code
